scientific_integrity: An exact incidence/Cauchy--Schwarz proof is provided; finite verifier tests do not replace the infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: The square-root coefficient is an upper bound and not proved sharp. The theorem does not give general exact profiles. Literature comparisons leave a residual risk of unindexed equivalents; formal independent scientific review has not been performed.
title: Square-root Abelian pattern-complexity bounds from bounded differences
